title: The Primitive and Diamond surfaces locally minimize the variance of Gauss curvature
summary: We prove that the Schwarz' Primitive (P) and Diamond (D) surfaces are local minimizers of the variance of Gaussian curvature among local deformations within the moduli space of triply periodic minimal surfaces of genus 3 (TPMSg3s). Our approach interprets the branch values of the Gauss map as a configuration of eight points on the sphere and expresses the variance of Gaussian curvature as the product of two integrals involving exponentials of Green's functions.
